scope: Reviewed developer wheel artifacts, not a runtime SBOM or redistribution clearance
notes: 40 locked packages; colorama is conditional on Windows and is not installed in any approved lane.
Wheel SHA-256 is checked against uv.lock before archive metadata/notices are inspected.
Wheel tags select ordinary CPython 3.13/3.14 Linux x86_64 or macOS arm64 artifacts; CI additionally checks each actual installed environment.
METADATA and available LICENSE/COPYING/NOTICE/AUTHORS/vendor.txt payloads are hashed without executing or extracting wheel code.
Top-level license labels do not describe every vendored component. Pip and mypy include third-party notices; development environment redistribution requires its own complete notice/source review.
uv, uv_build, Actions, and managed CPython are outside this lock inventory and recorded separately in dependencies.md.
